title: Invocation evaluation harness: oracle-driven tool selection & argument schema validation
creator: Marco Alvarez
description: Build an automated invocation evaluation harness that runs whenever a model variant or serving configuration changes. The harness should produce deterministic, explainable metrics for: 1) tool selection accuracy (precision/recall/F1 vs oracle expected tool for a prompt), 2) argument-level schema conformance (type, required/optional, value ranges, enums), and 3) failure modes (missing args, extra args, malformed JSON, semantic mismatches). Results are used to gate canary rollouts and to trigger alerts when regressions exceed configurable thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs automatically in CI for PRs that touch model-config or runtime routing rules
Produces per-change delta reports showing selection precision, arg-conformance rate, and top 5 failure examples
Integrates with rollout policies: a failing delta (>=2% drop in selection precision OR >=5% drop in arg-conformance) blocks canary promotion unless acknowledged
Dashboarding: time-series of metrics with ability to slice by model, config flag, prompt-class
Exportable artifacts: JSON report, CSV summary, sample prompt+response traces with golden oracle annotations
design_notes: We will implement an oracle layer that maps a curated set of prompts to expected tool invocation and argument shapes. Oracles are stored as CSV/JSON in the evals repo and referenced by prompt ID. The harness runs two evaluation passes: a fast syntactic validator (schema conformance using JSON schema / pydantic) and a semantic classifier for tool selection correctness (compare model's predicted tool to oracle label, handle aliases). To scale, sampling will be stratified by prompt class and by recent production traffic. We intend to reuse existing eval infra (evals-runner, metric collectors) and add a lightweight runner that can be executed in CI and as a nightly job. Trade-offs: strict JSON-only enforcement catches most regressions but will flag benign formatting differences; we will add normalization steps and fuzz-tolerant validators as a next step.
test_plan: Unit tests for schema validator with positive/negative examples
Integration test that runs harness against a local model artifact and compares metrics to a stored golden report
CI job that triggers on model-config or api-router changes and fails build when gating thresholds exceeded
Manual canary run against dedicated environment with dashboard verification
Post-deploy 7-day drift job that compares baseline to live traffic and surfaces regressions
